summary: A nonfaithful quotient action invalidates the final Lie-algebra inference in the central orbit-symmetry proof. Exact counterexamples establish three additional local defects. The geometric splitting conclusion is not refuted.

problems.title: Zero induced field versus zero quotient-algebra element
problems.claim: The zero induced Killing field is used to conclude Phi(Z)=0 and Z=0 for Z in m.
assumptions: Connected semisimple L without compact simple factors, finite center
problems.check: M=H^3 with g=2(dx^2+dy^2+dz^2)/z^2; L=SO_0(3,1); N horizontal translations; m=so(2). Z=-y*d_x+x*d_y is nonzero, Phi(Z) is nonzero, but its induced field on the height quotient vanishes. All geometric assumptions checked analytically; vector-field identities computed exactly.
problems.result: The displayed algebraic inference is false; quotient-action effectivity is unavailable.
problems.counterevidence: The action on M is effective and its orbits are symmetric. The intended geometric conclusion survives. Reading check-Z=0 as shorthand for a field still does not justify injectivity of the algebra map.
problems.impact: Proposition 7.1 is used in Corollary 7.4 and Theorem A. Core proof dependency supports Major, independently of repair length.
problems.correction: At a compatible p, Z*_p is both N-horizontal by Corollary 6.6 and N-vertical by Lemma 7.2. Thus Z is in h, hence M_0<=H. Equation (14), K=M_0 H, gives H=K.
problems.repair_verification: local analytic replacement checked, conditional on preceding lemmas

problems.title: Incorrect backwards Gram-Schmidt vector and density
problems.claim: The displayed u1 is the backwards orthogonal residual and yields the weighted density.
problems.check: H=[[2,1,1],[1,2,1],[1,1,2]], principal minors 2,3,4. Source u1=(1,-1/2,-1/2), corrected=(1,-1/3,-1/3); source cubic density 9, correct 8.
problems.result: The general non-diagonal formula is false.
problems.counterevidence: The diagonal specialization is correct; no diagonal restriction is present in the general statement.
problems.impact: Illustrative formula; definitions and abstract density estimates do not depend on this formula in the inspected source.
problems.repair_verification: analytic Gram determinant identity and exact SymPy check

problems.title: Missing absolute determinant in automorphism law
assumptions: Connected nonabelian nilpotent Heisenberg group times R
phi=diag(1,1,1,-1) is an isometric Lie algebra automorphism
problems.check: All 16 bracket identities and phi^T phi=I checked exactly; det phi=-1. Both densities are 1, RHS of printed formula -1.
problems.counterevidence: Main application in Lemma 4.2 has determinant one and is not invalidated by this sign issue.
problems.impact: Local overextension of the transformation law.
problems.correction: Use |det(phi)|^(-1), or state and enforce an orientation-preserving restriction.
problems.repair_verification: consistent with the absolute-determinant construction and exact example

problems.title: Same-group lifting fails for a flat circle

location.anchor: Theorem 9.2 and statement after Theorem B

assumptions: Effective proper isometric cocompact G action
problems.claim: G action lifts as the same group to the universal cover, giving G^0 subset Isom(R^k).
problems.check: M=R/(2pi Z), G=S^1 acting transitively by translations. Universal cover is R. A continuous connected compact subgroup of Isom(R) is trivial, so no faithful S^1 embedding exists; rotation through 2pi lifts to a nontrivial translation.
problems.result: The global group-level assertion fails, while the universal-cover geometric splitting holds.
problems.counterevidence: Theorem 9.2 does not require M noncompact. A flat cylinder with S^1 x R action gives a related noncompact obstruction.
problems.impact: Additional group assertion and wording of lifting step; not the negative Einstein splitting result.
problems.correction: State a conclusion about lifted Killing fields or a covering group, with its kernel specified; do not assert an embedding of G^0 itself.
problems.repair_verification: obstruction proved; no unspecified faithful global lift claimed
